goal.text: Keep a running account of what she has done since stepping outside, so she knows whether anything of hers is still out in the yard before going back in.

turns.text: Which hand got that door open?

trigger.detail: the patio door finished swinging open

expected_answer.text: Both hands at first, then you pushed it the rest of the way open with your right one.

turns.text: — did it stay open, or swing shut?

trigger.detail: walked through the opening still holding it

expected_answer.text: You kept hold of it while you stepped through, so it stayed open; you never looked back at it.

turns.text: mm-hm — mm, wait, how did I get down?

trigger.detail: reached the handrail at the top of the steps

expected_answer.text: Down the outside steps. You took one rail in your right hand, turned, took the second with your left, then went down.

turns.text: actually — before that, did I go straight out, or stop somewhere first?

trigger.detail: quiet stretch while walking away from the house

expected_answer.text: No. You were heading for the kitchen, veered left instead, and crossed the dining area to reach that exit.

turns.text: I keep touching my face — anything with my glasses?

trigger.detail: nothing new for about eighteen seconds

expected_answer.text: Once. About half a minute in you stopped, turned, and held them steady with both hands for a few seconds.

turns.text: — right, and am I still carrying anything?

trigger.detail: arms came down to the sides

expected_answer.text: Nothing in either hand. Your arms dropped to your sides a while back and have stayed there.

turns.text: um, hang on — who's actually out here with me?

trigger.detail: a second voice has been audible for a while

expected_answer.text: One other person, walking alongside you since you came off the steps. You have been talking with them the whole way.

turns.text: What on earth am I doing now?

trigger.detail: a long unremarked stretch of walking

expected_answer.text: Marching. You have been lifting your knees high and swinging your arms in time for roughly eight seconds.

turns.text: Is the way indoors behind me, or to one side?

trigger.detail: gaze dropped away from the seating and onto the ground

expected_answer.text: Behind you and to your right. You came down onto the grass from that side and have not faced it since.

turns.text: — oh, I've just grabbed something off the ground. What is it?

trigger.detail: bent down and closed a hand on something

expected_answer.text: A piece of fruit. You bent over, took one in your right hand, then picked up the one beside it with your left.

turns.text: sorry, quick one — so I'm holding two?

trigger.detail: stood upright and started walking again

expected_answer.text: Just one now. You passed it from your left into your right and you have been tossing it as you walk.

turns.text: And it's gone now?

trigger.detail: released it towards the other person

expected_answer.text: Yes. You stepped back, cupped it in both hands for a moment, then sent it over to them right-handed.

turns.text: Did I drop that, or did they?

trigger.detail: straightened up after retrieving it

expected_answer.text: Neither of you held on. It came back, you raised both hands, missed, turned around and jogged after it.

turns.text: that's not — sorry, I meant did I get it before it stopped rolling?

trigger.detail: walking back towards the other player

expected_answer.text: It had already come to rest. You walked up, leaned over, and lifted it off the grass with one hand.

turns.text: Something's on my arms — what am I checking?

trigger.detail: broke off the rally to bend both elbows up

expected_answer.text: The devices strapped to each wrist. You bent both elbows up and looked them over without putting anything down.

turns.text: oh — by the way, how many throws in?

trigger.detail: a pause in the rally

expected_answer.text: Seven have gone across to them so far, counting the very first one you lobbed over after standing up.

turns.text: — nice. Just keep the count going for me.

trigger.detail: the user sets up a standing instruction

expected_answer.text: Will do. I will flag it if it changes hands or ends up on the ground again.

turns.text: Right, that's enough of that. Have I been looking down the whole time we were throwing?

trigger.detail: gaze came up off the ground and settled on the greenery

expected_answer.text: Mostly down, yes. Your eyes only lifted away from it when you stopped and turned a moment ago.

turns.text: I've climbed up into something. Can you tell what?

trigger.detail: focus left the planting as she went up and in

expected_answer.text: A playhouse. You walked up, turned right, climbed, then bent forward to get in through the opening.

turns.text: oh, before I forget — what happened to the ball?

trigger.detail: settled inside, nothing to report

expected_answer.text: You sent it back to them just past four minutes and never had it again. Your hands have been empty since.

turns.text: — good. Don't let me forget it's out here.

trigger.detail: a second standing instruction

expected_answer.text: I won't. I will raise it before you head back inside.

turns.text: I'm up again — what did I use to pull myself off the ground?

trigger.detail: attention moved as she rose and reached for support

expected_answer.text: Their hand first, then a wooden post. You took it with your left, swapped to your right, and stood.

turns.text: Someone's touching me — what are they doing back there?

trigger.detail: gaze slid off the planting as the colleague reached in

expected_answer.text: Adjusting your gear. They straightened the band on your right wrist, then reached round and touched one on your back.

turns.text: hey, sorry — so are we done out here?

trigger.detail: standing still, conversation winding down

expected_answer.text: Looks like it. Your hands are on your hips and you have started walking again, with no equipment in them.

turns.text: — before we go in, then: what do I need to pick up?

trigger.detail: the user closes out the errand

expected_answer.text: Nothing of yours. The other player has had it since your last throw, so you can walk straight in.
